To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the use of Senticnet features in combination with psycho-linguistics and lexical features enhances the performance of personality recognition from texts.
the use of affective and sentiment polarity based features with psycho-linguistics and frequency based features improves the personality recognition performance.
common sense knowledge based personality recognition from text is a promising area of research.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the following aspects: (1) To identify the most suitable features for personality detection, (2) To combine psycho-linguistics, common sense knowledge based and frequency features and to analyze the impact on the accuracy of personality recognition and (3) To design and develop a new framework for personality recognition from text.
the development of a framework for the automatic personality recognition from the text using common sense knowledge and sentiment polarity scores.
the use of common knowledge with affective information for personality detection from text.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

common sense knowledge based personality recognition from text has shown significant improvement over the existing approaches which use only psycho-lin-guistic features and lexical frequency based analysis.
the proposed framework is a promising architecture to identify personality traits associated with a text.
our framework outperforms the state-of-the-art approaches by 3.3%, 3.4%, 3.6%, 2.8% and 2.7% for the five personality traits respectively.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have proposed a novel architecture to detect personality from text using common sense knowledge and affective information.
our work shows that common sense knowledge with polarity scores and affect labels is an important resource in personality detection.
we are able to achieve 0.81, 0.81 and 0.82 F-measure for the personality traits of Openness, Conscientiousness and Extraversion respectively.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the use of Senticnet with sentiment polarity scores, affective labels and common sense knowledge enhances the accuracy of personality detection.
the use of affective and sentiment polarity scores with common sense knowledge enhances the accuracy of personality detection.
common sense knowledge based approach can be a useful tool to improve accuracy in personality detection.
